text_block_list.text:
"I bumped into Tokai Teio,
who was heading somewhere with heavy steps."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... Why do I have to get
another checkup today too~...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
As you can see, I'm totally healthy!
Tests are just a waste of time!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, the examination room is so cramped and suffocating!
Everyone's in pure white clothes with super stern faces..."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"...C'mooon, Trainer.
Can't you just take the medical checkup for meee..."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Instead, I'll just laze around in the Trainer's Office for you...
However, I couldn't take her place, so with a sigh, I watched Tokai Teio head off to her medical examination...
